verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say developers can create deposit and wallet accounts held in FBO structures, with sub-accounts and customer wallets as listed use cases, all reachable via API. That maps to per-customer accounts and sub-accounts under a master (FBO) structure. The evidence never says these accounts get unique account and routing numbers, and it does not describe reconciliation-oriented virtual accounts or issuance at scale. Missing for 10: explicit issuance of unique account/routing numbers, virtual accounts for reconciliation, per-customer collection account docs, evidence of scale, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue unique account and routing numbers at scale — virtual accounts for reconciliation, per-customer collection accounts, and sub-accounts under a master structure

citations.quote: Create deposit accounts and wallet accounts held in FBO structures. Support use cases including operating accounts, customer wallets, sub-accounts, and multi-party fund flows
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components
